title: chrootuser: replace our home-grown read-from-chroot with os.OpenInRoot()
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Instead of starting a child process that chroots and pipes the contents of a file to its stdout, use the new os.OpenInRoot() from the standard library, which is faster.

Split the list of users in a group and check for the user's name in the resulting slice instead of assuming that a substring match is enough.                              

#### How to verify it

More unit tests!

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

None
